name: Collapsible Search
description: A button that expands into a pill-shaped search form. Accepts all standard button parameters to configure the trigger appearance.

componentSettings.label: Colors
componentSettings.description: Component-local colors for the search field, panel, and border.

settings.label: Field Color
settings.description: Controls the search field background and its readable text contrast.

settings.label: Panel Color
settings.description: Controls the surrounding panel and close-button color scheme.

settings.label: Border Color
settings.description: Controls the field outline that separates it from the panel.

componentSettings.label: Layout
componentSettings.description: Component-local sizing and spacing. On small screens the expanded field still fills its container.

settings.label: Minimum Field Width
settings.description: Minimum desktop field width, measured in base units.

settings.label: Maximum Field Width
settings.description: Maximum desktop field width, measured in base units.

settings.label: Control Size
settings.description: Scales the field and its action buttons together, measured in base units.

settings.label: Field Insets
settings.description: Adjusts the field's horizontal inset, measured in space units.

componentSettings.label: Motion
componentSettings.description: Controls the duration of the expand and collapse sequence together.

settings.label: Motion Duration
settings.description: A lower value makes the sequence faster; a higher value makes it more deliberate.
